result.title: BiGrounder: Bidirectional Training Unlocks the Potential of GUI Grounding
result.summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) grounding aims to map natural language instructions to precise operational coordinates, serving as a critical task for autonomous agent interaction. Current approaches formalize GUI grounding as predicting action-coordinate pairs from instructions, with end-to-end training supervised solely by final coordinates. Training datasets typically provide only a small number of descriptions per target coordinate, whereas real-world scenarios involve a much larger set of varied descriptions for the same target, which limits robustness to linguistic variation. While recent GUI grounding paradigms have begun employing reinforcement learning to enhance localization accuracy, models with limited exploratory capability before reinforcement yield constrained improvements even with identical training data during the reinforcement phase. To overcome these limitations, we propose a bidirectional reward paradigm that enables model self-reinforcement. During SFT, bidirectional training equips the model to generate action descriptions from target coordinates. During RL, the model samples semantically consistent instruction variations on-policy and grounds each variation back to its target. A cycle-consistency gate couples semantic quality to grounding success, turning the model's own instruction policy into a source of continually refreshed reinforcement trajectories. Our 4B-parameter model achieves competitive accuracy across five grounding benchmarks in our evaluation, indicating the effectiveness of the proposed training paradigm. https://github.com/Spell-shi/BiGrounder

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 GUI grounding，提出双向训练范式：SFT 阶段让模型由目标坐标反向生成操作描述，RL 阶段对同一目标在线采样语义一致的指令变体并重新定位，并用循环一致性门控将语义质量与定位成功绑定，以自我生成可刷新的强化轨迹。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「生成—回定位」循环一致性门控可能为 LVR 中自生成推理轨迹的筛选与奖励设计提供核查线索，但该工作只做坐标级 grounding，不涉及 latent 推理状态或视觉证据选择。
